steps.title: Requirements Analysis
steps.description: Analyze user requirements for building a beautifully-designed, premium Modern Calculator app.

steps.title: Metadata Initialization
steps.description: Generate general metadata profiles and structure paths for the package com.moderncalculator.app.

steps.title: Gradle Configuration
steps.description: Set up AGP 8.3.2, Gradle 8.5, targetSdk 34, and compileSdk 34 parameters matching strict build guidelines.

steps.title: Custom UI Styling Assets
steps.description: Generate clean drawable XML backgrounds with modern gradients, responsive click states, and clean circular corners for buttons.

steps.title: Display Backdrop Asset
steps.description: Configure dynamic border layout shape and styling for the calculator formula display screen background.

steps.title: Layout Architecture Design
steps.description: Assemble high-end visual responsive button layout grids and display scrolling panels inside the main XML template.

steps.title: Manifest Declaration
steps.description: Register MainActivity inside AndroidManifest.xml and initialize system material theme alongside custom application settings.

steps.title: Engine Core Mathematical Parser
steps.description: Incorporate a strict recursive descent parser in pure Java 8 to handle advanced equation syntax, bracket order, and decimal arithmetic.

steps.title: Display Event System Integration
steps.description: Integrate dynamic output calculations, error exceptions, formula overflow scrollings, and layout linkings inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Responsive Buttons Logic Binding
steps.description: Programmatically link numeric digits, operators, deletion actions, parenthesis, and evaluation listeners seamlessly.

steps.title: Decimal and Result Precision Handler
steps.description: Program decimal precision systems and trim floating limits (such as handling infinite loops and scientific fractions neatly).

steps.title: Equation Syntax Sanitizer
steps.description: Add functional code logic to validate mathematical entries and swap duplicate operator chains on-the-fly.

steps.title: Pre-Build Structural Evaluation
steps.description: Ensure strict code architecture sanity compliance for Java 8 compatibility and SDK-native compilation tools.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Assemble and construct clean package build bundles through gradle debug tooling automation pipelines.
